verified_source_context_spot_checks.scope: Dialogue with Trypho 71–73: Justin's own allegation, not a modern proof of coordinated textual suppression
Divino afflante Spiritu §§14–22, especially 20–22: juridical Vulgate authenticity vs original Hebrew/Greek
Sahih Muslim 2135, explanation of 'sister of Aaron' by naming conventions
Against Heresies V.33 §§1–4, early earthly-kingdom interpretation; not equivalent to crude carnal chiliastic caricature

Mystici corporis Christi §§22–23, visible membership and faith
Guérard des Lauriers, French interview, materialiter/formaliter section §§I-III; reprint source, not certified 1979 edition
Satis cognitum, visible unity and Petrine governance
Pastor aeternus, dogma of primacy and infallibility; not blanket inerrancy
